messages:
Aly: quick thread - I'm landing a compact playbook for prefetch vs micro-batch vs bulk-batch for the Optimize toolkit. Will include TypeScript + Python examples, a tiny compatibility note for renamed qprofiles, and an ops canary checklist. Need SDK + infra eyes.

Ben: sounds useful. please add a one-paragraph decision rule: when to use prefetch (stable user ctx), when to use micro-batch (latency-sensitive bursts), when to use bulk-batch (throughput).

Aly: will do. TS example draft:
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD })
await c.optimize.prefetch({ model: 'rwd-7b-quant', prefetchKeys: ['ctx'], batchSize: 4, quantProfile: 'q-short-v2' })
```

Carlos: small nit: our Go SDK now uses OptimizeClient() not Optimize(). Also include a fallback snippet that routes to non-quant model if qprofile missing.

Aly: adding Go snippet and fallback example. Python sample will match TS.

infra-bot: please include recommended autoscale knobs: target p95 token latency < 200ms, max batch size 32 for low-latency pools.

Ben: add a tiny perf table for 8/64/512 tokens even if approximate. PMs want numbers.

Aly: ok adding quick numbers from local harness and linking to artifacts. CLI used: `tools/eval/harness --suite=prefetch-playbook --model=rwd-7b-quant --tokens=8,64,512 --runs=25`

docbot: CI/link-check queued when PR opened.

Aly: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 - assigning @Ben @Carlos.

docbot: CI/link-check completed for PR #5120 - status: success :white_check_mark:

Carlos: reviewed and left two minor code style comments. Go compatibility note added.

Ben: LGTM on content. left a wording tweak in the decision paragraph.

Aly: merged and patched a relative link in the batching guide. Thanks all! Closing thread, will monitor telemetry for 24h.
